infra_detail.t1_coverage: SkepticInfraError: coverage infra failure: every one of the 0 context strings the run recorded is empty. The pinned rc sets `dynamic_context = test_function`, so a run that honored it records one context per test somewhere. Nothing anywhere carrying a name means the setting was not honored, and then no line in the report can be told from a line that ran at import. A patch whose own lines lack a test context while the rest of the run has them is the H9 hard fail, and this is not that. A coverage number Skeptic cannot stand behind is an infra failure, never evidence: a silent 0% fails a gold patch and poisons the published false-positive rate. Next: check `dynamic_context` in collect/artifacts/candidate/coveragerc and the coverage version in the image, then re-run the pair.
